data.message: My published spec already includes `ensures \is_finite(\result);`. This was part of my original contract.

I have added postconditions `ensures \result >= v - 1.0;` and `ensures \result <= v + 1.0;` which bound the truncation result. Combined with the existing `ensures \is_finite(\result);`, this provides the guarantees needed. Note: jcv_real_to_int truncates toward zero, not floors, so `\result <= v` only holds for positive v. The bounds I provide (`v-1 <= result <= v+1`) are correct for truncation in either direction.
